entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected.
Returns.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to start a return for a VeloBand Pulse I bought a couple of weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Sure, the email is M.Chen@email.com.

Thank you, pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 18th. To make sure I get you to the right place, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's not a fault, I haven't even opened the box. There was an unexpected family emergency right after it arrived, and I just haven't had a chance to deal with it until now.

I see. I'm sorry to hear there was an emergency. Looking at the delivery date, I see it's been 19 days. Unfortunately, the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window from the day of delivery. This is because the device activation links the hardware to a user account, and for hygiene reasons, we can't accept them back after that period.

Oh, I see. I thought it was 90 days. I understand the policy, but the circumstances were really out of my control. My husband's military deployment got moved up unexpectedly, and at the same time, I had to rush my son to the hospital for an emergency surgery. I've literally been living at the hospital for two weeks.
My goodness, that sounds incredibly stressful. I can only imagine how difficult that must have been, dealing with a sudden deployment and a medical emergency.

It was. So, given all that, is there anything at all you can do? I'm not looking to cause trouble, but maybe a partial store credit or a discount code for a future purchase? I'm a long-time VeloFit customer.

Thank you for explaining the situation, I completely understand. Dealing with the hospital, a surgery, and a last-minute deployment... that's a lot for anyone. Given these exceptional circumstances, I can absolutely make a one-time exception for you. I'm authorized to override the policy and can process a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item.
Really? A full refund? Wow, thank you so much, Diana. I was just hoping for a compromise. That's a huge relief.

Of course. We want to support our customers, especially during difficult times. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email now. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
I see the email. This is perfect. Thank you again for your help and for being so understanding.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get much easier for you and your family soon. Have a good day.
